summary.description: A few sentences about the week in the yard as a whole, read before any individual task. Name every task whose status is deferred, and what would release it.

taskId.description: The id of a task from the plan you were given. Select from that plan; never invent an id.

text.description: The sentence a person reads for that task, in plain language.

tasks.description: The tasks worth a sentence this week. The Planner sets the order they appear in.

text.description: Something you noticed that no rule produced, in a sentence or two.

advisories.description: Observations no rule in the plan produced. Never repeat a task's annotation here, because the reader already sees it on the task. An empty array is a normal answer.
